theme: An open Sunday in Maine, with a few overdue threads worth closing.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan, so the whole shape of it is yours. The only things really asking for you are a couple of loose threads: a call to lock in with Eugenia and Mike's surgery to start prepping for.

needsAttention.title: Lock in the PRI call with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia offered Monday 12–2 your time (that's tomorrow) or Thursday for the PRI conversation, and she's waiting on you to pick a slot.

needsAttention.title: Start Mike's surgery prep
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland; your prep task is overdue and flags confirming pre-op instructions with the surgeon's office by tomorrow.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: A reminder that your next virtual visit is Tuesday, Aug 18 at 10:00 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley holdings notice
flagged.detail: A proxy/holdings information notice from Morgan Stanley Private Markets & Alternatives is waiting.

flagged.title: Valoris note on the StePs research
flagged.detail: Marc recapped a chat with you about widening the IMC discussion beyond asset managers; you're cc'd, nothing owed.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos — NYT Cooking, The New Yorker, WSJ, Schoolhouse, Fog Linen, Folio Society, Amtrak.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox is waiting on you.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: A quiet Maine Sunday with nothing on the calendar to answer to.
The open stretch to lock the PRI call time and get ahead of Mike's surgery prep.
Tomorrow holds the possible noon PRI call and Milica Boskovic's birthday.
